INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
